svg.text: Chatify Project Report
Full Stack Real-Time Chat Application
Team Members
1. Shobuj Chandra Das (250221009) - Backend development
2. Chancal Hawladar (250221014) - Frontend development
3. Avijit Das Apon (250221013) - Database design
4. Md. Raihan (250221012) - API integration, Vercel and Render hosting
Objective
The objective of Chatify is to build a secure real-time messaging platform with
authentication, online presence, image sharing, responsive UI, and encrypted messages.
Motivation
Modern communication needs fast delivery, data privacy, and easy access from mobile
and desktop devices. This project was created to practice full-stack development and
deployment using the MERN ecosystem with Socket.IO.
Background
Chatify uses React and Tailwind CSS for the frontend, Node.js and Express for the API,
MongoDB for persistence, JWT cookies for authentication, Socket.IO for real-time
communication, Cloudinary for image uploads, and AES-256-GCM for message encryption.
Methodology
Users register or log in, select contacts, send text or image messages, and receive
updates instantly through authenticated socket connections. Messages are encrypted
before saving to the database and decrypted only when returned to authorized users.
Result Analysis
The application supports real-time messaging, online/offline status, secure session
handling, responsive chat layout, and encrypted message storage.
Future Work
Future improvements can include message read receipts, typing indicators, group chat,
file sharing, message search, and stronger key management for encryption.
